titles: 11년 바다에 못 나간 미 핵잠수함…미 해군이 한국을 찾은 진짜 이유
11년 못 고친 미 핵잠수함, 미 해군장관은 한국에 "브라보 줄루"
4일 만에 배 띄우던 미국이 잠수함 하나를 포기했다…그런데 한국은
thumbnail_texts: 「11년 멈춘 미 핵잠수함」 + 미 해군장관은 한국으로 갔다

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사 — 멈춘 잠수함 / 충격받은 미 해군 장교 / 미 해군 보급선을 정비하는 한국 도크
thumbnails.prompt_en: Hyper-realistic HDR three-panel contrast composition. On the left, a rust-streaked black Los Angeles-class nuclear submarine sits idle at a gray, foggy U.S. Navy pier in desaturated tones, paint peeling and ropes sagging. In the center, an American naval officer in his 50s in khaki uniform, shown from the chest up and filling most of the frame height, stares with a shocked, open-mouthed expression. On the right, a gleaming South Korean shipyard with a giant orange goliath crane holds a gray U.S. Navy supply ship in warm golden backlight with a blue-white glow. An American flag waves in the top-left corner and a South Korean flag (Taegeukgi) waves in the top-right corner, both as realistic fabric.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사 변형 — 녹슨 잠수함과 멈춘 크레인 / 자신감 있게 웃는 한국 조선소 작업자 / 불꽃이 튀는 울산 도크
thumbnails.prompt_en: Hyper-realistic HDR three-panel contrast composition. On the left, a lonely rusted submarine rests in a dim, dusty American dry dock with motionless cranes and cracked concrete. In the center, an attractive Korean shipyard worker in his 40s with a warm likeable face, wearing blue coveralls and a white hard hat, is shown from the chest up with a confident smile and open arms. On the right, a massive new ship hull stands in a bright Ulsan dry dock with welding sparks and brilliant warm backlight. An American flag waves in the top-left corner and a South Korean flag (Taegeukgi) waves in the top-right corner, both as realistic fabric.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사 — 녹슨 빈 선대(과거의 조선소) / 후회하는 미국 노년 조선공 / 상선과 군함이 나란히 선 한국 조선소
thumbnails.prompt_en: Hyper-realistic HDR three-panel contrast composition. On the left, an abandoned American shipyard with an empty, rusted slipway and faded sepia traces of a World War II Liberty ship, covered in dust and cracks. In the center, an American shipyard veteran in his 60s with a weathered face, shown from the chest up, looks back with a regretful, wistful expression. On the right, a sunlit South Korean shipyard shows a huge LNG carrier and a gray naval warship side by side in the same yard, glowing in golden hour light. An American flag waves in the top-left corner and a South Korean flag (Taegeukgi) waves in the top-right corner, both as realistic fabric.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사 변형 — 도크 앞에 줄 선 잠수함들 / 답답해하는 미 해군 장교 / 정비를 마치고 출항하는 미 해군 보급선
thumbnails.prompt_en: Hyper-realistic HDR three-panel contrast composition. On the left, several black submarines wait in a line outside a closed, weathered dry dock gate under a gray overcast sky, like a traffic jam at sea. In the center, an American naval officer in his 40s in navy working uniform, shown from the chest up, holds a clipboard with a frustrated, troubled expression. On the right, a freshly painted gray U.S. Navy supply ship leaves a bright South Korean shipyard with tugboats, sparkling blue water and warm sunlight. An American flag waves in the top-left corner and a South Korean flag (Taegeukgi) waves in the top-right corner, both as realistic fabric.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드 — 비 오는 밤의 미국 해군 부두 / 방명록에 서명하며 감탄하는 미 해군 고위 관계자(익명) / 밝은 한국 조선소 도크
thumbnails.prompt_en: Hyper-realistic HDR three-panel contrast composition. On the left, a rainy night at an American naval pier with a dark submarine silhouette and dim, flickering lights. In the center, an anonymous senior American naval official in his 60s wearing a dark suit, shown from the chest up, signs an open guestbook with a surprised, admiring expression. On the right, a brilliant South Korean shipyard dry dock with towering cranes and a gray U.S. Navy supply ship under clear daylight with a blue-white glow. An American flag waves in the top-left corner and a South Korean flag (Taegeukgi) waves in the top-right corner, both as realistic fabric.
